agent_status.completed:
Research report saved at `evidence/research/REPORT.md`.

The strongest finding is that the supplied assistant-ui thread remains a credible foundation: it already combines a sticky composer, return-to-latest control, streaming state and message actions. At 1280×600, the observed six-line composer expanded upward by roughly 112 pixels and reduced the visible reading area. Its generic document attachment tiles also rely on hover or focus disclosure to distinguish filenames, according to source inspection.

Vercel AI Elements, MUI X Chat and shadcn-chatbot-kit provide useful alternatives, but none was visually trialed in this workspace. The report identifies their practical adoption costs and unresolved compatibility and licensing checks. Captured baseline images and public-source retrieval are retained alongside the report. No product code was changed.
